label: late-episode D1 after a rare-unrewarded a1 trial (a1 -> S2, no reward)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2) and only in the last ~20 trials of an episode (ep_trial >= 80; zero activity before trial 70, rate rises toward 90-99). Within that, it fires when the previous trial was unrewarded (99% of mass) and, most specifically, when the previous trial was a1 that transitioned rarely to S2 and went unrewarded -- the case where a model-based agent should stay with a1. Consistent with this, almost all activations precede an upcoming a1 choice (policy logit a1-a2 moderately positive, 2.8-8) with low value, and occur mostly when S1 is the good state. Does not fire after rewarded trials, after a2 choices, or before trial ~75. The recorded predicate uses only observed variables (previous trial history and trial index); adding the upcoming a1 choice (choice > 2.5) adds little. About 15% of activation mass sits at the window first trial (rel -3), where the previous trial is outside the window, which caps recall; some weaker activations also occur after other unrewarded S2 outcomes (e.g. a2 -> S2 common). Dev F1 0.76, mass recall 0.83.
